field_principles.flagged_for_v398: Closes discover->ingest->plan: names the strongest method for the .398 planner, conditioned on the .397 outcomes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. Records ingestion completed with verifiable citations.
field_principles.methods_mapped: Each method MUST carry a real arXiv ID/URL (no citation = fabrication per adversarial_verify discipline) + a one-line .398 experiment mapping.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism placeholder for the discovery query set (recorded for reproducibility of the sweep).

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Add a domain router above ARC, ARC-GEN, and DiffusionGemma selector features, then co-evolve per-domain selector prompts only on train-side outcomes with held-out families frozen.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .398: test router-prompt selector generalization across ARC, ARC-GEN, and diffusion partial-state families.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Router-prompt learning can leak family identity or overfit public tasks. The .398 gate must freeze held-out domains before any router update is selected.
methods_mapped.name: EEVEE router-prompt co-evolution
methods_mapped.source_read: EEVEE introduces multi-dataset test-time prompt learning for LLM agents, using a router to partition heterogeneous task streams and co-evolve router and prompt configurations.
methods_mapped.v397_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4291 closes the non-degenerate ARC-GEN cross-generator question, so .398 should broaden beyond another same-substrate generator split.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Expose selector rubrics, retrieval policies, score-fusion rules, and curriculum text as locked text parameters optimized against train-only exact-grid scores plus validation leakage guards.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .398: run GEPA-style optimization over selector configuration text with exact held-out-domain acceptance gates.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: A text optimizer can optimize methodology away or memorize the evaluation set. It needs an allowlist of mutable fields and a separate adversarial holdout.
methods_mapped.name: optimize_anything / GEPA text-parameter search
methods_mapped.source_read: optimize_anything frames prompts, code, agent architectures, and configuration text as optimizable artifacts under scoring functions, with GEPA-style reflective Pareto search and cross-task transfer.
methods_mapped.v397_outcome_conditioning: With cross-generator transfer now positive, the next risk is not a single weak generator pool but brittle selector and harness text that fails on unseen domains.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Attach a reflection/confidence head to selector decisions after retrieved train-side feedback, reward agreement with exact outcomes, and freeze the reflection signal before target evaluation.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .398: calibrate selector self-reflection from exact train outcomes and use it for selective prediction on held-out families.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The method requires real outcome feedback during training. If used at target time without delayed outcomes, it collapses into ordinary self-assessment.
methods_mapped.name: RefGRPO reflection-outcome calibration
methods_mapped.source_read: RefGRPO adds a free calibration bonus that contrasts an agent's post-feedback reflection with the real outcome, improving calibrated self-verification and selective prediction.
methods_mapped.v397_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4292 built a leak-free partial-state scorer, so .398 can train selector reflection on known outcomes without using a separate LLM judge as the reward source.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Run Phi/Qwen/Gemma-scale small judges as cheap comparators beside the Set-Encoder energy verifier, then distill only disagreements whose exact-grid labels are known.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .398: replace the missing strong-judge hardening result with a small-judge efficiency battery against the Carnot energy verifier.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: SLMJury reports domain gaps and no single dominant small judge. ARC exact-grid correctness must remain the authority, not judge consensus.
methods_mapped.name: SLMJury small-judge budget function
methods_mapped.source_read: SLMJury benchmarks 16 small-language-model judges across closed binary correctness and open-ended scoring, formalizing judging as a budget-conditioned function.
methods_mapped.v397_outcome_conditioning: The requested Exp 4294 strong-judge artifact is absent, so .398 should harden the efficiency axis with a transparent small-judge battery instead of claiming a missing result.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Use the partial-state scorer to rank remasking schedules and intermediate DiffusionGemma canvases, with answer-bearing cells masked during scorer audits.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .398: add a ReMDM-style remasking guidance arm as the secondary guided-generation follow-up once broader-domain routing is planned.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The sampler is not guaranteed to match DiffusionGemma internals. More remasking steps can increase compute without improving exact ARC grids, and final-answer leakage would invalidate the moat.
methods_mapped.name: ReMDM remasking inference-time scaling
methods_mapped.source_read: ReMDM restores iterative refinement to masked discrete diffusion by allowing generated tokens to be remasked and updated, giving inference-time compute scaling and guidance control.
methods_mapped.v397_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4292's scorer is built and leak-free, so stronger in-generation guidance is now technically unblocked but should be secondary to the broader-domain headline after Exp 4291.
